name: BeltsAndMoreAnimationFreeze-Unofficial-2-1Fix
title: Belts (and more) Animation Freeze (Unofficial 2.1 Fix)
author: Avongard, purple_cpu_chip, FuzzyGames
description: Original mod by FuzzyGames (based on Avongard's belt animation freeze, with purple_cpu_chip); Factorio 2.1 fix by kfsone. Freezes belt animations for people who get migraines or suffer sensory overload. Stops animating transport belts, splitters, underground belts and loaders, plus (2.1) lane splitters, linked belts and 1x1 loaders. Replaces the original BeltsAndMoreAnimationFreeze: disable/remove the original. Original: https://mods.factorio.com/mod/BeltsAndMoreAnimationFreeze
